title: Mixed use element objectives
text: O4.14.1 Mixed use development enhances the streetscape and activates the street. O4.14.2 A safe and secure living environment for residents is maintained through the design and management of the impacts of non-residential uses such as noise, light, odour, traffic and waste.
notes: Register C4P2-129: Vol2 Appendix A6 (summary list of all element objectives) is deleted with no draft equivalent, so these O records are the only listing of the 4.x objectives.
